_about: Valerius Flaccus, Argonautica, in English. No complete public-domain English translation is known (Mozley's Loeb is 1934). Raw IA OCR of two Book I translations: an anonymous English verse version (London; catalogue date [1808], catalogue attribution to T. Noble, whose name the title page does not print), and H. G. Blomfield's prose (Oxford: Blackwell, 1916; US public domain by date).

valerius-flaccus-anon-1808-book1: The First Book of the Argonautica of C. Valerius Flaccus Setinus Balbus, in English verse (London; catalogue date [1808])
valerius-flaccus-blomfield-1916-book1: The Argonautica of Gaius Valerius Flaccus Setinus Balbus, Book I, translated into English prose with introduction and notes (Oxford: B. H. Blackwell, 1916)

_translator_unchecked.valerius-flaccus-anon-1808-book1: the title page names no translator; T. Noble is the archive.org catalogue's attribution only
_translator_unchecked.valerius-flaccus-blomfield-1916-book1: the title page OCR garbles the name (BLOMYETELD, M.A., I.C.S., late scholar of Exeter College); H. G. Blomfield per the catalogue
